verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?

(2) Page 13 shows the LA cable continuing down to the 'LA Pit' and 'DC Earth Pit' annotated at ground level in the side passage, with consistent orange routing annotation. The Enphase micro-inverter architecture means there is no DCDB on this project; the circuit goes panels+micro-inverters → trunk cable → IQ Gateway (Enphase accessories box, page 16) → solar meter → main meter.

No orphan ends or unexplained breaks are visible. Colour coding is consistent throughout. The routing is appropriate for an Enphase micro-inverter system with no DCDB.
